property_summary: After Collect, the caller's balance recorded in the contract does not exceed its total deposits minus the sum of collected amounts.
After Collect, the caller's balance recorded in the contract decreases by exactly the amount collected.
After a successful Collect call, the sum of all balances in the contract never exceeds the total ether deposited minus the total ether sent out via Collect.
After a successful Collect call, the caller's recorded balance in the contract decreases by the amount collected, not by zero.
The balance of any address that has never called Collect remains unchanged after a Collect call by another address.
After Collect, the caller's balance is decreased by exactly the amount collected, and the total balance of the contract plus all user balances remains unchanged.
After Collect, the sender's balance is unchanged if the condition is not met.
After Collect, if the caller's balance is less than MinSum, then the caller's balance remains unchanged (i.e., Collect reverts because condition fails).
After Collect(_am), the caller's balance is always decreased by exactly _am (i.e., balances[caller] decreases by _am).
After Collect, the caller's balance cannot decrease if the caller's balance is less than MinSum (i.e., the guard condition ensures no deduction when insufficient balance).
After any sequence of operations ending in a Collect call, the caller's balance in the contract is unchanged if the deposited amount was zero.
After any sequence of deposits and collects, the caller's balance in the contract should be exactly the sum of deposited amounts minus collected amounts.
After any sequence of calls ending in Collect, the contract's balance for any address that never deposited (i.e., whose first deposit amount was 0) must be 0.
After any sequence of deposits and collects, the sum of all balances in the contract is exactly the contract's own ether balance.
After any sequence of operations ending in Collect, the caller's balance never exceeds the sum of msg.value values in Deposit calls made by that caller.
After a Collect call, the caller's balance is less than or equal to the MinSum if the caller had insufficient balance to collect.
For any key k deposited with nonzero value, the Collect function on C preserves the deposit (no burning) whereas M can silently destroy it.
After calling Collect with a given amount, the sum of all balances across any set of addresses remains the same as before the call if no actual transfer occurred.
After any Collect call, if the total ETH balance of the contract decreased, then the caller's balance decreased by exactly the amount withdrawn.

After a Collect call that reverts, the total contract balance remains unchanged; if Collect succeeds, the caller's balance decreases by the collected amount and the contract balance decreases by the same.
The MinSum value after Collect never changes from its initial set value.
After a successful Collect call, the MinSum value remains unchanged from its value before the call.
After calling Initialized and then SetMinSum, the MinSum value in state equals the value passed to SetMinSum, regardless of deposits and Collect.
After SetMinSum is called before Initialized, the stored MinSum equals the argument passed, regardless of subsequent deposits and Collect calls.

After SetMinSum is called before Initialized, the stored MinSum equals the argument passed, regardless of subsequent deposits and Collect calls, but MinSum never changes after Initialized is set to true.
After a call to Collect, MinSum remains unchanged when it was set before initialization.
MinSum is never changed by a call to Collect.
After a call to Collect with any parameters, MinSum remains equal to its value before the call.
MinSum does not change after initialization.
MinSum remains unchanged after any call to Collect.
The value of MinSum after any Collect call equals its value immediately before that Collect call.
MinSum remains constant after the contract is initialized, regardless of any Collect call.
After initialization, the value of MinSum can only decrease.
After a Collect call, MinSum is always less than or equal to the initial value set before Initialized
After Collect, P.MinSum stays equal to whatever was set by the last SetMinSum call (before initialized), while M.MinSum is always 0.
After Collect is called, MinSum remains unchanged from the value set by SetMinSum before initialization.
After calling Collect, MinSum equals the value set by the last call to SetMinSum before initialization, as long as that value is nonzero.

After calling Collect, the value of MinSum returned by the public getter is equal to the value set by the last call to SetMinSum before Initialized, provided the call to SetMinSum occurred before Initialized.
The value of Log is never address(0) after a call to Collect.
After any call to Collect(uint256), the Log address remains non-zero.
After any call to Collect(uint256), the Log variable's address is the same as the address passed to SetLogFile.
After a call to Collect(uint256), the SetLogFile address equals the log address set in setUp.
After Collect, the Log address is the one that was set via SetLogFile.
After any Collect call, the total Ether balance of the contract plus the sum of all user balances (from the public getter) must equal the total Ether ever sent to the contract.
After Collect, the caller's balance in the contract should decrease by exactly the amount collected, and the total contract balance plus all user balances should remain invariant.
After a Collect call, the caller's recorded balance in the contract decreases by exactly the amount collected.

After a Collect call, the Deposit function's effect on the contract's Ether balance is preserved: the contract's balance equals the sum of all recorded user balances plus any unrecorded Ether (since the buggy Deposit does not update balances).
After a Collect call, the total Ether held by the contract equals the sum of all balances in the mapping plus any ether received via unlogged deposits.
Collecting when the sender's balance is less than MinSum should revert.
Collecting should not succeed when the sender's balance is less than MinSum.
Collect with an amount that exactly equals the caller's balance should succeed only if that balance also meets or exceeds MinSum.
Collecting a non-zero amount should revert when the sender's balance is less than MinSum.
Collect should only succeed when the caller's balance is at least MinSum.
After a successful Collect call, the caller's balance should decrease by exactly the amount withdrawn.
After a Collect call that succeeds (does not revert), the sum of all user balances in the contract must decrease by exactly the withdrawn amount.

After a Collect call that succeeds (does not revert), the log entry for the last message should have the same Val as the amount withdrawn (the caller's balances[msg.sender] should be decreased by _am).
After a successful Collect call without revert, the sum of all user balances in the contract plus the contract's ether balance decreases exactly by the withdrawn amount.
After a successful Collect call, the caller's balance mapping should decrease by exactly the withdrawn amount.
The contract should send the exact amount requested by the user, not zero, in a successful Collect call.
After a successful Collect call, the recipient's balance should increase by the amount _am, not 0.
After a successful Collect call, the caller's balance in the contract decreases by exactly _am.
After a successful Collect call, the sum of the caller's balance in the contract and the caller's Ether balance is decreased by exactly _am.
After a successful Collect call, the contract's total Ether balance decreases by exactly _am.
